description: Settings of the Buildkite pipeline nisavid/dotfiles that the buildkite/dotfiles merge gate relies on: whether a pull request commit gets a build, which steps the build runs, and which commit status it reports to GitHub. scripts/buildkite-pipeline-settings checks them against the live pipeline. See docs/research/BUILDKITE_GHA_PR_BUILDS.md.

pipeline_settings.configuration:
steps:
  - label: ":pipeline: Upload"
    agents:
      queue: linux-small
    command: |
      if [ -f .buildkite/pipeline.yml ]; then
        buildkite-agent pipeline upload
      else
        echo "No .buildkite/pipeline.yml on this commit; nothing to run."
      fi
